text:
The Flyers close a five-game road trip at 1-1-2 on it, coming off a 3-2 overtime loss at Edmonton, where Evan Bouchard won it. They're 1-2-2 in their last five. The Blue Jackets are winless in three (0-3-0), outscored 12-4, after a 3-1 loss to Tampa Bay on Thursday. It's a Metropolitan Division game, with Philadelphia seventh and Columbus eighth, the Flyers two points ahead. Columbus won the first meeting 4-3 in overtime on Oct. 27.

Our numbers say the Flyers are better than their record. At five on five, they've taken 43% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), against 48% for Columbus. Finishing has cost them: 9.8 fewer goals than their chances usually produce. Neither team prevents chances well. The power plays are close to even, and the projected goalies, Dan Vladar (PHI) and Jet Greaves (CBJ), have both been below expected this season (-1.2 and -1.6 goals saved above expected) after strong years last season (+12.7 and +15.0). Greaves has had it worst lately, at .858 over his last five starts. We have it close: 3.05 expected goals for Columbus, 2.85 for Philadelphia.

Matvei Michkov is the Flyers' best bet to score at 27%, the seventh overall pick in 2023, and the subject of a playing-time debate. Charlie O'Connor of PHLY Sports posted that "Tocchet's version of events doesn't tell the whole story." For Columbus, Adam Fantilli is 49% for a point, and we like him as an under-the-radar pick because his line creates chances. Our other under-the-radar pick is Michael Bunting, a fourth-liner at 13% to score who has had dangerous shots lately. Both are players to watch, not locks.
